entries.84cbcb6ace9bd18b: The company has a single segment, the M&A Mediation Business, and its reportable segments also consist of only 1 business, the M&A Mediation Business. According to materials from a study group of the Small and Medium Enterprise Agency, about 260,000 corporate enterprises have owners aged 60 or older with undecided succession intentions, and demand for succession-type M&A driven by a shortage of successors forms the foundation of the market. The number of deals closed in the fiscal year ended May 2026 was 49, and the cumulative number of deals closed reached 300 in March 2025. In the current period there was no revenue from external customers outside Japan; in the prior period, revenue was ¥1,701 million from Japan, ¥159 million from the UK and ¥31 million from Taiwan.

entries.f00d73fae281312e: The company adopts a fully success-based fee system: it charges neither sellers nor buyers retainers or interim fees, and no fee arises unless a deal is concluded. The minimum success fee is ¥15 million, set lower than the ¥20 million to ¥25 million charged by 4 listed major M&A mediation specialists, giving it price competitiveness in the small-deal segment, where transfer amounts are ¥300 million or less. The success fee is also calculated on the basis of transaction value, which lowers the burden on clients compared with asset-based calculation methods. Deals are not divided among staff; instead, 1 consultant provides end-to-end support from consultation through closing.
